notes: Literals that survived later drafts, plus Draft 8 markers B / s / a. Recreated; dmitry-ra suite not copied.

cases.title: Null is marker Z
cases.paragraph: The null value is the single byte 0x5A (ASCII Z).

cases.title: True is marker T
cases.paragraph: The true value is the single byte 0x54 (ASCII T).

cases.title: False is marker F
cases.paragraph: The false value is the single byte 0x46 (ASCII F).

cases.title: Empty buffer is not a value
cases.paragraph: Every value starts with a one-byte type marker.

cases.title: 0x00 is not a type marker
cases.paragraph: A type marker must be one of the defined ASCII markers.

cases.title: Draft 8 byte marker B
cases.paragraph: Draft 8 stored a signed byte as marker B plus one payload byte. Draft 12 replaced B with i / U.
cases.notes: Draft-8 marker. A Draft 12 decoder must reject B.

cases.title: Draft 8 string marker s
cases.paragraph: Draft 8 used lowercase s plus a one-byte length. Draft 12 uses S plus an integer numeric length.

cases.title: Draft 8 length-prefixed array marker a
cases.paragraph: Draft 8 used marker a plus a count, not the streaming [ ] pair.
